summary: Fix interaction channel check on external servers and show ErrorId in console logs.

changes.text: Fix NullReferenceException in channel checks on external servers
changes.desc: Fall back to interaction channel ID so user-installed context commands (Explain, Ask Chino) run in servers where Chino is not a member.

changes.text: Show ErrorId in text console output template
changes.desc: Reference IDs (E-XXXXXXXX) are now visible in plain text stdout logs.

changes.text: Fix /user info silent failure in DMs and external servers
changes.desc: Prevent Discord 400 Bad Request error on empty banner URLs, add guild null-safety for non-guild callers, and await paginator dispatches.

changes.text: Dynamic Bot & Gateway version display on /status
changes.desc: Display live liveness, database readiness, and runtime version badges for both Discord Bot Core and API Gateway on the status dashboard without exposing internal metrics.

changes.text: Fix SynchronizationLockException in AgentRuntime.StartAsync
changes.desc: Replace thread-affine Monitor lock with async-compatible SemaphoreSlim in AgentRuntime to prevent exit failures when unwinding async state machines on ThreadPool transitions.

summary: Major release featuring the new Music Engine with Lavalink v4 crossfade, self-healing AI circuit breaker and live topology graph, native SkiaSharp Canvas Studio, unified Support Desk with YouTrack ticketing, 3-level RBAC, and the root workspace dashboard.

changes.text: Lavalink v4 Crossfade & Automix Integration
changes.desc: Full client integration of Lavalink v4 Crossfade API (/crossfade [enabled] [duration]) with seamless audio transitions, automatic track reservations, and audio analysis-backed automix windows.

changes.text: Centralized PostgreSQL Music Catalog & Spotify Integration
changes.desc: Universal database cache (music_tracks, music_lyrics) providing zero-latency song resolution before falling back to Spotify Web API, supporting albums, playlists, charts, and Spotify Canvas video loops.

changes.text: Synchronized Lyrics with Real-Time Sliding Window
changes.desc: Word- and syllable-level synchronized lyrics playback via /lyrics and player button with a dynamic 3,800-character window preventing Discord rate limits.

changes.text: /seek Command & Precise Position Scrubbing
changes.desc: Added /seek slash command and dashboard scrubber slider with flexible timestamp parsing (mm:ss, seconds, hh:mm:ss) and track duration validation.

changes.text: Standalone /music Web App & Personal Playlists
changes.desc: Full-screen Apple Music Tahoe-styled desktop and mobile web player with personal playlists CRUD (/api/v1/me/playlists), server playback, queue management, and delta SSE streaming.

changes.text: Dedicated Player Channel & Smart Lifecycle
changes.desc: One dedicated PlayerPanel per server with permission auto-detection, typed request support, in-memory activity ring buffer (500 events), voice co-presence checks, and idle auto-leave.

changes.text: Self-Healing AI Circuit Breaker & Failover Router
changes.desc: Per-model-alias circuit breaker with sliding window trip thresholds, 5-minute HalfOpen canary cooldown, and tier-bypass fallback cascading failing requests to healthy higher tiers ordered by lowest cost.

changes.text: Real-Time AI Topology Graph in Admin Console
changes.desc: Interactive draggable and zoomable canvas in the Next.js Ops Console fed by live SSE streams, showing in-flight turn counters, model health, electric pulse cables, and failover beams.

changes.text: Multi-Lingual AI Safety & Zero-Vulnerability PromptGuard
changes.desc: Leetspeak normalization, base64 instruction decoding, and prompt injection detection across 8 languages, with delimiter fencing (<<<USER_CHAT_CONTENT>>>) and system model identity scrubbing.

changes.text: 3-Phase AI Access & Anonymous Guest Sessions
changes.desc: Granular AI access control for Members, Signed-in non-members, and 2-hour HMAC-SHA256 anonymous guest sessions validated via Cloudflare Turnstile with zero message history persistence.

changes.text: Interactive Docs Assistant with Dashboard Element Guidance
changes.desc: AI documentation assistant that answers queries, validates links against live generated docs, and opens dashboard settings pages while highlighting up to 5 target UI elements sequentially.

changes.text: Native C# SkiaSharp 2D Rendering Engine
changes.desc: In-process SkiaSharp 2D rendering pipeline replacing external Node.js canvas service (saving 250MB+ RAM), supporting layered backgrounds, circular avatars, avatar decorations, text gradients, and progress bars.

changes.text: Web Canvas Studio & Custom Font Management
changes.desc: Interactive visual template editor (/dashboard/[id]/canvas) with real-time SkiaSharp previews, drag-and-drop layer controls, custom TrueType/OpenType font uploads (5MB cap), and 1-click slot assignments.

changes.text: Unified Multi-Desk Support Desk with AI Triage
changes.desc: Complete replacement of Ask Desk with multi-desk support system featuring automated AI ticket triage, custom desk instructions, moderator escalation to private Discord threads, and live transcript streaming.

changes.text: YouTrack Ticketing Integration & Discord DM Follow-ups
changes.desc: Seamless bug and suggestion intake to YouTrack CHI project via /report and web forms, with Turnstile anti-abuse protection and opt-in 2-way Discord DM reply routing.

changes.text: 3-Level RBAC (None / Read / Write) & Master-Detail Permissions
changes.desc: Granular role-based access control separating read-only inspection from settings mutation, backed by a unified module registry and Master-Detail management UI for roles and members.

changes.text: Honeypot Trap Channels & AutoMod Exemptions
changes.desc: Automated Honeypot rule engine that catches unauthorized trap channel messages and applies immediate timeouts/kicks/bans, alongside new AutoMod exempt roles, channels, and categories.

changes.text: Role Transition Triggers & Hardened Cron Scheduling
changes.desc: Added role_direction condition (role added or removed) to the visual automation builder, with UTC-aligned cron scheduling, natural language AI drafting, and error recovery.

changes.text: Scheduled Server Analytics Reports & /analytics Command
changes.desc: Automated periodic server analytics reports delivered to Discord channels with optional AI conversation summaries, alongside an interactive standalone /analytics slash command.

changes.text: Root Workspace Shell & Flat Design Skin
changes.desc: Unified dashboard workspace moved to root (/dashboard, /chat, /me/*, /together/*) with flat outline-free styling, floating palette, server tour, and live usage meters.

changes.text: Beta 3D Spatial Showcase (/beta)
changes.desc: Interactive WebGL Aura shader stage with 3D perspective card deck, pointer-reactive tilt physics, real WebM feature video loops, and a 16-module visual feature atlas.

changes.text: Personal Chino User-Installed App Commands
changes.desc: Right-click message actions (Explain, Ask Chino, Summarize, Translate) and personal onboarding that work in DMs and external servers without requiring bot guild membership.

changes.text: Chino Together Group Plans & Voice Handoff
changes.desc: Coordinate plans with interactive member availability time grids, ranked choice voting, RSVP attendance tracking, and automatic voice channel moves upon event start.

changes.text: Discord Components V2 Panels & 1-Click Web Links
changes.desc: Rebuilt Discord interactive panels (/configure, /mod, /music, /automate, /economy) with Components V2 layout, custom title emoji support, and direct 1-click web dashboard deep links.

changes.text: Bot Internationalization (BotLocalizer)
changes.desc: Resource bundle-backed localization system supporting English and Japanese across slash command responses, panel sections, and user onboarding.

changes.text: Structured JSON Logging for Grafana Loki
changes.desc: Serilog JSON output formatter emitting machine-readable logs with trace IDs, request IDs, ErrorId tags (E-XXXXXXXX), and live dynamic exception stack toggling in /admin console.

changes.text: PostgreSQL 18 Database Migration
changes.desc: Complete migration from legacy Apache Cassandra to PostgreSQL 18 with 75+ idempotent schema migrations, connection pooling, and transactional integrity.

changes.text: Clean Configuration Architecture
changes.desc: Eliminated legacy YAML configuration files in favor of strict separation: environment variables for secrets and network bindings, and database rows for tunable product settings.
